params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If specified, object is an object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable or a field.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is specified) or Variable or field (if * is omitted)

params.name: listType
params.description: Type of list to set: Choice list, Required list, or Excluded list; defaults to Choice list (0) if omitted.

sentinelValues.meaning: Choice list -- simple list of values to choose from (default if listType is omitted)
Required list -- lists only values accepted for entry
Excluded list -- lists values not accepted for entry

params.name: list
params.description: List reference number, or 0 to end the association for the given listType

overloads.semanticRole: Associates or replaces the hierarchical-list association of the given type (choice/required/excluded) for the object(s) designated by object and *, using a list reference number.

constraints: list must be a reference number produced by Copy list, Load list, or New list.
Passing 0 in list ends the association for the given listType; it does not free the list reference from memory -- call CLEAR LIST when the list is no longer needed.

Existing values are replaced differently depending on how the list is bound to the object: a plain choice-list association replaces the list itself; an array-bound list is replaced by copying into array elements; an object-bound list (not supported in binary databases) is copied as collection elements into the object's values property.
